name: @craftos/agent-app-pi
description: Agent App Framework plugin for Pi (earendil-works/pi): the /agent-app launcher command, the six framework skills, and an extension that makes Pi reachable from `agent-app bridge`. Pi drives the agent-app and a2app CLIs with its own bash tool.
